shots.action: Two people outside on a residential street by a doorway, mid-conversation. The hero is saying he'll help on Saturday. Hands loose and gestural, the way people talk when saying something casual they'll forget
shots.camera: medium two-shot, eye level, slightly off axis
shots.notes: No ask. He says it and forgets it. The device catches it. Friend is generic.
shots.label: 1 · Follow-through · Tuesday

shots.action: The hero alone a few days later, coming in through his front door, keys in one hand, phone in the other
shots.camera: medium, from inside the hallway, eye level
shots.notes: No ask. It surfaces on its own. Jacket over the t-shirt to sell time passing.
shots.label: 1 · Follow-through · Friday
shots.reply: You told Tario you'd help him move. That was Tuesday.

shots.action: Kitchen. Steak in the pan, tongs in the hero's hand, leaning over it
shots.camera: medium, slightly above hob height, angled down
shots.label: 2 · Learns from you · March
shots.reply: Not yet. Give it another minute.
shots.reply_note: Line drafted by the agent on the producer's request for a card here; producer to confirm wording.

shots.action: Same kitchen, weeks later. Raw steak on a board on the counter, the hero standing back from the hob, both hands empty
shots.camera: medium, eye level, hob and board in frame
shots.ask: "How do I not overcook this again?"
shots.label: 2 · Learns from you · Weeks later
shots.reply: Last time it sat eleven minutes. You flipped it once, late.

shots.action: Living room. An older woman at an upright piano, mid-story. The hero a step away, standing, listening, hands at his sides
shots.camera: medium wide, eye level, afternoon light
shots.label: 3 · Keeps the moment · Sunday

shots.action: The hero alone in front of a framed photo on a wall, close enough to be looking at one thing, hands at his sides
shots.camera: medium close, over the shoulder toward the wall, photo soft
shots.notes: No phone. The framed photo must be a snapshot of the S05 moment: attach the approved S05 still as a third reference (@photo). Runs after S05 is picked. No card: the audience assumes the recall. Producer decision.
shots.label: 3 · Keeps the moment · Years later

shots.action: The hero at a desk, stressed, work spread in front of him, laptop open, papers. He has stopped, hands still, looking at nothing in particular
shots.camera: medium, slightly high angle across the desk
shots.ask: "How can I use my time better?"
shots.notes: Stress as body: shoulders up, hand near face or flat on the desk. Not a caricature.
shots.label: 4 · Sees the pattern · Months in
shots.reply:
You get less done on the days you skip the walk.
Go first thing in the morning.
